lines.text: Large crowds travel with Jesus, and He says whoever does not hate even his own house cannot be His disciple.
Jesus says whoever does not carry his cross and follow Him cannot be His disciple.
A man who lays a tower's foundation but cannot finish it is ridiculed by everyone who sees.
A king with ten thousand men, unable to face a king with five thousand, sends a delegation for peace.
Anyone who does not give up everything cannot be Jesus' disciple, and salt that loses its savor is thrown out.
